name: scripture2slides
description: Turn a Bible passage into presentation slides (PowerPoint, PDF) or a verse image, with the translation's credit line.

interface.longDescription:
Turn a Bible passage into presentation slides or a verse image in the chat. Name the passage, and if you like a translation, a design and a layout. Scripture2Slides shows a preview and gives PowerPoint and PDF downloads for slides, or a PNG image in square, portrait or story size. Each slide and image carries the translation's credit line.

For church volunteers, worship and media teams, pastors, teachers, and anyone who shares Scripture online.

Translations: the 13 open translations that Scripture2Slides supplies: Berean Standard Bible, King James Version, World English Bible, Literal Standard Version, American Standard Version, Young's Literal Translation, Darby, Douay-Rheims 1899, Reina-Valera 1909, Bíblia Livre, Louis Segond 1910, Lutherbibel 1912 and Riveduta 1927. Licensed translations such as NIV, ESV and NLT are not available.

Limits: slides take one chapter and at most 50 verses at a time; an image takes at most 4 verses. Download links work for 24 hours. To change the text or the design further, open the result on scripture2slides.com. No account or sign-in is needed.
defaultPrompt: Make PowerPoint slides for Psalm 23 in the KJV
Turn Romans 8:28-39 into worship slides, one verse per slide
Make an Instagram verse image of Philippians 4:6-7

positive.description: Slides for a passage in a named translation
positive.prompt: Make PowerPoint slides for Psalm 23 in the KJV
positive.expected_behavior: Calls make_bible_slides with reference Psalm 23 and version KJV. The card shows 6 slides with the KJV credit line and Download PowerPoint, Download PDF and Another design buttons.

positive.prompt: Turn Romans 8:28-39 into worship slides, one verse per slide
positive.expected_behavior: Calls make_bible_slides with reference Romans 8:28-39 and layout one_verse_per_slide. The PowerPoint has 12 slides, one for each verse, in the default BSB translation.

positive.prompt: Use Scripture2Slides to make an Instagram verse image of Philippians 4:6-7
positive.expected_behavior: Calls make_verse_image with reference Philippians 4:6-7. The card shows the image, a Download image button and the translation credit line. With no design named, the tool uses the first design in which the passage fits on one image.

positive.prompt: Which dark slide designs does Scripture2Slides have?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_slide_designs with style dark. The card shows each dark design with its preview picture, name and summary.

positive.prompt: Make slides of all of Psalm 119
positive.expected_behavior: Psalm 119 has 176 verses and the tool makes at most 50 at a time. ChatGPT splits it into parts of at most 50 verses (for example 4 decks) or offers the parts; a single 176-verse call returns a clear error saying so.

negative.description: Explaining a passage needs no slides
Slides that are not a Bible passage
negative.prompt: Make a PowerPoint about my company's quarterly results

negative.description: Song lyrics are not a Bible passage
negative.prompt: Make lyric slides for Amazing Grace

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: Bible slides (PowerPoint and PDF), verse images and a design list for 13 open translations.

es-ES.subtitle: Versículos en diapositivas
es-ES.description: Convierte un pasaje bíblico en diapositivas (PowerPoint y PDF) o en una imagen con el versículo, con la línea de crédito de la traducción. Incluye 13 traducciones abiertas, entre ellas la Reina-Valera 1909. No hay NVI ni otras traducciones con licencia. Las diapositivas toman un capítulo y hasta 50 versículos; una imagen, hasta 4 versículos. Los enlaces de descarga funcionan 24 horas. No hace falta una cuenta.
